evidence_text: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles metadata: archive raster DTM; GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km zipfiles; OS Grid alignment; metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn; EPSG:27700; available resolutions 0.25 m, 0.5 m, 1 m and 2 m; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; quarterly update frequency; revision date 2024-07-19; archive period 1996-12-01 to 2024-04-18; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints. Target remains BUILDING_PRESENT and local height-difference calculation is not performed by this producer.
